messages:
mike_infra: Heads up — onboarding new tenant `horizon-ai`; they need GPU capacity in Canada Central (ca-central-2). Can we open quota requests for p5, p4d and g5 families, plus increase SNAT EIP pool for the VPC?

sophia_cloudops: Thanks — can you paste the account ID, expected peak concurrent nodes, and go-live date? Also any preferred AZ spread?

mike_infra: Account: 874321098765. Target peak: 24 concurrent GPUs (mix: 8x p5, 8x p4d, 8x g5). Go-live: 2024-08-20 (pilot) then scale in Sept. AZs: prefer 2 AZs for redundancy.

raj_eng: are these on-demand or mostly reserved/dedicated? affects entitlement process and lead time.

mike_infra: Dedicated for sustained inference jobs; small burst via spot for noncritical batch. We'll request reserved/dedicated capacity but ask for some burst quota.

sophia_cloudops: Ok. I'll raise AWS Service Quotas + internal accelerator entitlement. Can you confirm the CIDR and whether we need additional private IPv4 ENIs? Also SNAT requirement (estimated concurrent NAT translations)?

mike_infra: VPC CIDR: 10.48.0.0/16. ENIs: we need 40 extra ENIs to support scaling and node replacement. SNAT: expect ~300 concurrent translations during bursts (mainly model downloads and telemetry).

olivia_oncall: note from network team: CA region has limited NAT EIP pools in our org. We'll request an extra 8 EIPs and pre-warm the NAT gateways. Also check S3 egress path for model pulls to avoid cross-region costs.

quota-bot: Support case created: CASE-2024-CA-9981. AWS Quotas requested: p5 family +8, p4d +8, g5 +8; ENI delta +40; Elastic IPs +8. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases/#/case/C-CASE-2024-CA-9981

sophia_cloudops: tagging for billing — add tag `cost-center:horizon` and `team:platform`. Also include estimate of monthly spend for finance approval.

mike_infra: rough estimate: $80k/month initially (heavy inference). I'll send a precise breakdown to finance.

raj_eng: include requested CLI snippets in the case to speed quota ops. e.g.:
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-XXXXXXXX --aws-region ca-central-2 --desired-value 8
```
(repeat per instance family and for ENIs/EIPs)

olivia_oncall: Network checklist I pushed to the ticket: route tables, NAT pre-warm, security group limits, peerings. Also request for ephemeral IP pool for model pulls to reduce SNAT pressure.

sophia_cloudops: I'll follow up with AWS TAM to expedite since this is enterprise tenant. ETA from support usually 3-7 business days for initial response; entitlement approval might take longer. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

mike_infra: great — ping me if they need any additional workload samples or IP ranges. thanks all. :rocket:
